title: Cover and Deadline
author: Paloma Villalobos
blurb: Petra Dravenmoor, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must extract a defector who may be the bait before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
